office_does: The coroner investigates unnatural, violent or suspicious deaths in Island County and can hold inquests.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Shantel Porter (Prefers Independent Party), elected in 2022 after serving as deputy coroner, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Island County Coroner for four years and a certified medicolegal death investigator; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Former deputy coroner; elected unopposed in 2022 [S3][S5]
Certified medicolegal death investigator since 2022, after a 28-year career in dentistry [S1]
Pledges transparency and compassion for families and careful attention to the facts [S1]
